title: Microsoft’s approach to incident management
description:
Today’s episode is all about how Microsoft does incident management internally.

Kenny Singh, Head of Cyber Security for Microsoft ANZ, is joined by John Dellinger, Chief Security Advisor for Microsoft, as he takes Kenny through Microsoft’s global approach to incident management.

You’ll hear John explain what all the terms actually mean when it comes to cyber security at Microsoft, what the key metrics are to help Microsoft continually improve and why having a good relationship between the business and the security team is so important.


This show is produced in collaboration with Wavelength Creative. Visit wavelengthcreative.com for more information.

title: Overcoming the challenges of a cyber security incident
description:
In today’s episode, you’ll hear 3 members of the Microsoft team take a deep dive into recovery and remediation. 

Kelly Taylor, the Security Identity and Compliance Services Lead at Microsoft is joined by Bronwyn Mercer, a solution architect working in Microsoft consulting services and Andrew Lynes, a principal consultant with Microsoft’s compromised recovery security practice.

You’ll hear the panel discuss the basics of compromised recovery, some of the challenges that an organisation faces during an incident and we’ll break down the three stages to recovery.


This show is produced in collaboration with Wavelength Creative. Visit wavelengthcreative.com for more information.

title: Threat containment and eradication
description:
In today’s episode, you’ll hear all about containing and eradicating threats from three members of the Microsoft team.

Ben D’anvers, the cyber security lead in the customer success unit for Microsoft, is joined by Tabitha Bauer the Director of Microsoft’s Detection and Response Team, and, from the Global Compromise Recovery Security Team at Microsoft, Alan Johnston.

The panel explores how to determine the scale of an attack, how response teams should approach containment and why, when it comes to cyber security incidents, it’s not a matter of if. It’s a matter of when.


This show is produced in collaboration with Wavelength Creative. Visit wavelengthcreative.com for more information.

title: How to detect and analyse threats
description:
In today’s episode, Jimena De Uria and Kate McKay from Microsoft are joined by Nick Klein, Executive Director at CyberCX, to discuss the detection and analysis phase of incident management.

You’ll hear them break down what happens at the moment that an organisation initially becomes aware of an incident taking place, the different events that characterise a security incident and the group will break down some best practices when it comes to threat detection.


This show is produced in collaboration with Wavelength Creative. Visit wavelengthcreative.com for more information.

title: Cyber security incident response 101
description:
In today’s episode, Mark is joined by two experts in the field of cyber security incident response to break down the basics.

You’ll hear from Jessica Hunter,  the Head of the ACC Cyber Security Services Division and a 17 year veteran in the Australian intelligence and security Community. And also joining Mark is Frank Santucci, the Co-Founder and CTO of Paraflare, a Microsoft managed detection and response security services provider.

The group explores some of the basics when it comes to cyber security incident response, they’ll examine how the world of cyber security has changed and the panel will share some good news stories from the world of cyber security.


This show is produced in collaboration with Wavelength Creative. Visit wavelengthcreative.com for more information.

title: How we manage cyber risk at Microsoft
description:
Today’s episode is all about how Microsoft manages cyber security internally. And to do that, you’ll hear from Abbas Kudrati, the Chief Cyber Security Advisor for Microsoft Asia Pacific.

Abbas will break down how organisational structures can provide enterprise-wide risk-based cyber security, the importance of having simple tools for making the right decisions and he’ll share some lessons on risk-based cyber security.


This show is produced in collaboration with Wavelength Creative. Visit wavelengthcreative.com for more information.

title: How to implement a risk monitoring program
description:
In today’s episode, you’ll hear from a panel of three cyber security experts as they discuss the topic of Risk Monitoring.

From Microsoft, Andy Hurren and Reshmi Hariharan are joined by Paul O’Rourke, the Global Cyber Leader & Managing Director at Boston Consulting Group. 

The panel will discuss the importance of risk monitoring, some of the challenges affecting risk monitoring approaches and how to overcome them, and the group will share a few tips to help when implementing an approach.


This show is produced in collaboration with Wavelength Creative. Visit wavelengthcreative.com for more information.

title: Where does risk response sit in your business?
description:
In today’s episode, Antoinette Jago, a security solutions expert at Microsoft, is joined by Sandro Bucchianeri, the group chief security officer at NAB to break down risk response.

You’ll hear where the risk function sits in this ever-changing world, how risk management roles fit into organisations and we’ll share a few tips on how to monitor risks after they’ve been responded to.


This show is produced in collaboration with Wavelength Creative. Visit wavelengthcreative.com for more information.

title: Practical approaches to evaluating cyber risk
description:
In today's episode, Farah Chamseddine, Cyber Security Architect at Microsoft ANZ is joined by Jennifer Stockwell, The National Cyber Security Principal at Telstra to explore all things risk assessment.

You’ll hear about the importance of risk assessments and how to conduct them, some practical approaches to evaluating cyber risks, and Farah and Jennifer go through a few recommendations that can help you define the cyber security risk appetite in your organisation.


This show is produced in collaboration with Wavelength Creative. Visit wavelengthcreative.com for more information.

title: Why your organisation should take a risk-based approach to cyber
description:
In today’s episode, Mark speaks to three experts in the field of cyber as they discuss how to effectively manage cyber risks.

You’ll hear from Katherine Robins, a 25-year cyber security industry veteran and the current leader of the Victorian cyber practice for KPMG. Mark will also be joined by Damien Manuel, the director of Deakin university’s cyber security research and innovation centre. And you’ll also hear from Kenny Singh, the head of cyber security at Microsoft ANZ.

Mark asks the group why organisations should consider a risk-based approach to cyber, how the pandemic affected our approaches to risk, and the panel will share their best practices when it comes to implementing a cyber risk program.


This show is produced in collaboration with Wavelength Creative. Visit wavelengthcreative.com for more information.

title: Identifying cyber risks in your business
description:
In today’s episode, Daniel Goffredo, Product Manager at Microsoft Security, is joined by Samantha Macleod, Managing Partner of the Security Collective, as they discuss cyber risk identification.

You’ll hear how to identify key assets within an organisation and how to protect them, how you can determine those assets’ risk profile, and how to evaluate the effectiveness of the controls that you’ve put in place to protect them.


This show is produced in collaboration with Wavelength Creative. Visit wavelengthcreative.com for more information.
